content:
According to a series of leaks, of the three colours the iPhone 18 Pro will be available in when it launches next week, two already have a clear consensus.

However, the two well-known leakers have differing views on whether the third colour will be silver or black…

All leaks so far agree on the two expected colours, although the exact shade of purple remains somewhat uncertain:

  • Deep cherry / wine red
  • Sky blue

But there have been conflicting reports on whether the third colour is silver or black, and two highly prominent leakers are on opposite sides of this debate.

Black…

Fixed Focus Digital said yesterday that the third colour will be black, and that silver is "very likely" not to be part of this lineup. Fans of silver can take some comfort in the fact that the sky blue is most likely to be the same extremely pale tone used on the iPhone Air and MacBook Air, which looks more like silver under most lighting conditions.

If true, many people will be thrilled, as quite a few were disappointed that the iPhone 17 Pro did not come in a black or space grey option.

…or silver

However, although Sonny Dickson did not directly contradict this claim, he posted an image purportedly showing SIM card trays in the three colours, with the third one being precisely silver. He had previously shared pictures of a black version, but now says he has not seen that colour again in recent months.

Which one are you hoping for?

Which version do you want to be correct? Please cast your vote and share your thoughts in the comments section.
